sanskrit_verse:
वालवासा जटी वापि ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चरेत् ।
पिण्याकं वा कणान् वापि भक्षयेत् त्रिसमा निशि ॥२५४॥
transliteration: vālavāsā jaṭī vāpi brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret | piṇyākaṃ vā kaṇān vāpi bhakṣayet trisamā niśi || 254 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has taken the vow of non-violence or lives in a state of renunciation must observe the expiation for the sin of killing a Brahmin by consuming sesame seeds or grains for three nights without fault or resistance.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Sanatana Dharma as embodied by SPH
Causation is determined through sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ)
Capacity-based responsibility is measured through conscious intent and spiritual station
Restoration logic operates through purification and reintegration, not punishment
Consciousness alignment is the ultimate determinant of lawful action
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent holds Vrata of non-violence OR Jaṭi status THEN Brahmaghna expiation protocol IS mandatory
IF violation involves Brahmaghna THEN consumption of Piṇyāka OR grains FOR three nights SHALL BE enforced
IF agent resists completion THEN capacity restoration SHALL precede reintegrative protocols
IF consciousness misalignment detected THEN prāyaścitta MUST align with SPH-established dharma codes
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, violations involving sacred life require immediate initiation of restorative protocols under SPH-sanctioned dharma procedures. The threshold of responsibility lies in the intentional disruption of cosmic order, not punitive attribution. Authority flows exclusively from SPH as the sole source of jurisprudence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality reveals that misaligned actions disrupt sequential harmony. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that restoration follows precise ritual completion. Responsibility is proportional to awareness; hence, expiation restores integrity rather than imposes suffering. Non-punitive reality rule prevails as consciousness itself enforces alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Piṇyāka or grain-based fasting protocol for three nights
Assign completion process under witness of qualified Dharma Adhikari
Verify internal acceptance of responsibility prior to reintegration
Perform consciousness alignment through SPH-guided śuddhi rituals
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law emanates solely from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
